shaders.evidenceQualification: User-supplied AE gameplay capture SHA256 0e7ac0d4d5e81a350ac35ea88f22b19b5bdde8f9848a66653a22fcc3f31145b8: event 4948 is the first use of the single-mip, single-sample, full-resolution FP16 scene target. Solid full-screen indexed triangle, unpredicated, full RGB writes, no blending or alpha-to-coverage, GREATER depth test with no depth writes or stencil, and no scissor or depth bias. Pixel (1281,712) fails at depth 1 and retains RGB (16512,27648,50432) before bloom. Capture qualifies the shader and target-initialization seam; fixed-DLL gameplay and release validation remain pending.

experimentalScreenUiObserver.authorityGap: Pinned CommonLibF4 owns UI, IMenu, BSScaleformRenderer layouts and the screen-space render reason, but has no named mapping for this screen-space submission routine. experimentalScreenUiObserver.evidenceQualification: Static review of exact on-disk Fallout4.exe 1.11.240.0 and its version-1-11-240-0 Address Library. Exact live fingerprints and current-artifact native/gameplay validation remain required before a support claim.
experimentalScreenUiObserver.lifetime: All four reviewed direct callers pass the native UI singleton in RCX and ignore RAX. The callee prepares its screen target, retains and iterates menuStack entries under the native read lock, invokes render reason 2, submits menus, releases retained entries, then submits the cursor. The shim forwards UI* without retaining it.
experimentalScreenUiObserver.thread: Synchronous entry scope on the observed current thread. Graphics independently requires the active immediate context and compatible Present thread before injection.
experimentalScreenUiObserver.completion: Return is not GPU completion: native PostDisplay dispatch and deferred Scaleform work follow. Keep the shared image encoded until the same Present and retain current resource/ordering rejection.

sceneCompositeObserver.authorityGap: Pinned CommonLibF4 maps DrawWorld::DeferredComposite and BSBatchRenderer::RenderPassImmediately but has no call-site mapping or typed method for the composite pass submission.
sceneCompositeObserver.evidenceQualification: Static review of the exact on-disk Fallout4.exe 1.11.240.0 and its version-1-11-240-0 Address Library. DrawWorld::DeferredComposite (RVA0x021F82A0) makes three direct calls to BSBatchRenderer::RenderPassImmediately (RVA0x0221FB60), at +0x1F5, +0x915 and +0x9DE. Each passes a stack-local render pass in RCX, a 32-bit value in EDX and zero in R8D, and the caller ignores RAX; the callee prologue consumes RCX, EDX and R8B. Community Shaders 0.4.0 identifies +0x915 as the BSDFComposite pass. The live call is rechecked before mutation; native gameplay validation remains pending.
sceneCompositeObserver.lifetime: The callee renders the caller's stack-local pass immediately and returns. The shim forwards all three arguments once and retains no engine pointer.
sceneCompositeObserver.thread: Synchronous on the calling render thread inside DrawWorld::DeferredComposite. Graphics independently requires the active immediate context and the observed Present thread before initializing a scene target.

imageSpaceObserver.authorityGap: Pinned CommonLibF4 exposes ImageSpace records and LUT data but omits the weather accumulation, room overwrite and manager transfer call mappings.
imageSpaceObserver.lifetime: Immutable game-data catalog owns record identities and normalized native LUT paths; invocation-local collection and fixed synchronized publication own all copied values.
imageSpaceObserver.thread: Producer, transfer and Gamma callbacks may use different threads. Scoped writer counts and revisions reject overlapping or stale publications; payload copies use one try-lock attempt. Room mutation spans the blend call through its LUT setter.

weatherGrade.loadedColorSemantics: NAM0 clears the full color array before copying eight-slot data or expanding legacy four-slot data with bytewise neighboring-slot means. DALC legacy data similarly expands to eight initialized slots. Loaded black is valid; serialized leaf absence is not a runtime missing-value marker.

nativeUiResources.evidenceQualification: Exact runtime-1.11.240 executable and Address Library static review, including registrar ABI, full descriptor copy, mode-1 native allocation, FullScreenBlur slot consumers, and native release/recreation paths. nativeUiResources.lifetime: Mode 1 copies all 32 property bytes synchronously into the native manager and creates dedicated native texture/RTV/SRV/UAV. Native manager reset releases them; three native reset paths subsequently invoke the same registered create callback. The shim retains no descriptor or COM references.
nativeUiResources.thread: Synchronous native renderer allocation lifetime; preserve one nonoverlapping manager/thread pair per initializer invocation and fail closed on overlap. Static evidence does not establish a permanent thread identity; later resets may use another thread.
